name: Blur Background
desc: Free background blur for video calls. No sign-in, no watermark, and it runs fully in the browser.
line: Blurs the background on any video call site, on the device, with no sign-in and no watermark.

name: Full Webpage Screenshot
desc: Captures a whole page beyond the fold with no network calls.
line: Captures a whole page beyond the fold in one pass at full resolution, with no network calls.

name: Teacher Fundraising Message Generator
desc: Turns a short note on what a classroom needs into a donor request ready to send.
line: Turns a short note on what a classroom needs into a donor request, as an email or a short social post, using only what was said.

name: Leave Broadcast Message Generator
desc: Turns who is out, when and what needs handing off into one clean message.
line: Turns who is out, when and what needs handing off into one broadcast message for Slack, email or WhatsApp.

name: GitHub Profile Summarizer
desc: Summarises what a GitHub user has shipped, from the username alone.
line: Summarises what a GitHub user has shipped from the username alone, using the GitHub API.

name: Fieldnote
desc: Turns a spoken or typed classroom observation into a structured report with highlights and flags.
line: Turns a spoken or typed classroom observation into a report with highlights, flags and next steps.

name: Contract Generator

line: Drafts a joining letter or exit agreement from a modular form, exported to PDF and ready for a human read.
